prediction_text: Direction: Britain votes to Leave — the referendum of 23 June 2016 (single dated event, day scale) returns a Leave majority, narrow rather than landslide, despite February polls showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecideds. The undecided bloc breaks disproportionately to Leave by polling day.
basis:
tradition/system: not labelled on the card (no tradition/system field); system actually used: Western mundane astrology (national charts).
Basis: card facts — assessment published July 2015 and firmed in February 2016 from the UK national charts (1066, 1801, 1922), with Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day. Uranus exact and angular on the day is the disruption/separation signature in mundane doctrine — a break with the existing union rather than continuity — which outweighs the early 'Stay' polling lead given the very large undecided share the card notes. Margin graded narrow because the same card shows a divided electorate.
